title: Pair-wire index bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean symbols, and let $C,n,s$ be natural numbers. Define $D$ to be the number of states of $M$ plus $6$ times its number of work tapes plus $5$. If $D\le C$, then every pair consisting of a Boolean value and a codec bit has wire index less than $2C(s+n+1)$.
